name: Pinch Time
body:
Source Heroes from the Fringe pg. 21
Often having one parent with a human lifespan and one with an elven lifespan, many half-elves have a skewed perception of time, and none more so than the Spireborn, who also study the subject of time academically.

Prerequisites: Character level 5th, Spireborn half-elf.

Benefit: Once per day, as a standard action, you can gain the benefits of haste until the end of your next turn.
